evidence.ACL: Interstitial hyperintensity signal of ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury.
evidence.MCL: The contour of PCL, MCL & LCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus in this study.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus in this study.
evidence.PF OA: Wearing of articular cartilage of patella, major at patellar ridge,in favor of grade 2-3 chondromalacia
evidence.Baker's: A lobulated cystic lesion with internal septums in popliteal fossa with a small recess of the knee joint capsule lies medially between the tendons of the medial head of the gastrocnemius and the semimembranosus muscles with some fluid collection along medial side of gastrocnemius inferior to the cystic lesion, R/O ruptured Baker's cyst.
evidence.Contusion: No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
evidence.Fracture: No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction noted at distal femur and proximal tibia and fibula in this study.
